method: MVA author-code structure transfer to the existing public QA development partition

paper.title: Hallucinated Span Detection with Multi-View Attention Features

scope.source_partition: Reuse existing material-group split; this is a task/data interface change from the paper.
scope.label_interface: Map released human answer character spans to exact native answer tokens; preserve untouched existing lexical/window labels separately.

feature_interface.conversion: Permute the second and third 1024-column blocks only; retain type-major, layer-major, head-major order.
feature_interface.signal_readout: Keep pinned author-code full-sequence attention statistics at original answer token positions, including incoming attention from later positions; offline.

preprocessing.unit: One complete answer per sequence; no sliding-window or sentence splitting.
preprocessing.ignored_handling: Delete all -1 positions and corresponding feature rows, then compress the sequence. Not partial-label CRF.
preprocessing.padding: Right-pad labels with -1 and features with zeros to the global maximum valid length. Supply both label mask and key-padding mask.
preprocessing.author_global_max: Computed from train, validation and test lengths.
preprocessing.normalization: Each partition separately, for each type/layer/head feature, mean and sample std over all answers and all padded positions; std==0 becomes 1. Padding participates. No fit-only scaler.
preprocessing.current_scope_difference: Only fit/cal are available. Do not open sealed test or pretend cal is an independent test. A development-only maximum over available partitions must be explicitly disclosed; final three-partition padding/normalization remains to be fixed before final test opening.
preprocessing.original_label_builder: Notebook strips token-space markers and searches the first occurrence of label text in concatenated full input, with hard-coded answer boundary +7. It does not use original label start/end.
preprocessing.proposed_label_adapter: Exact existing raw token offsets and original human character spans replace model-specific boundary/search heuristics only. Native labels include punctuation where an annotation intersects; common lexical evaluation keeps old gold unchanged.
preprocessing.skip_guard: Original author code silently skips absent/all-ignored rows; interface must inventory such rows and must not silently remove any of the current 3839 answers.

architecture.positional_encoding: Fixed sinusoidal encoding, base 10000; added after input dropout.
architecture.transformer_layer: Bidirectional MultiheadAttention(d,h,p), residual dropout + post LayerNorm; Linear(d,2048), GELU, dropout, Linear(2048,d), residual dropout + post LayerNorm.
architecture.crf_start_end_initialization: Library default; source does not overwrite.

optimization.loss: -CRF(emissions,tags,mask) with library default summed reduction, divided by total valid tokens in this batch.
optimization.optimizer: torch.optim.AdamW, searched learning rate and weight decay, other defaults
optimization.precision: Author CUDA autocast and GradScaler; no explicit BF16 conversion; FP32 parameters at initialization.

early_stopping.monitor: validation token micro F1 after Viterbi
early_stopping.restore: Last state accepted by delta criterion, not every numerical maximum.

optimization.failed_trials: Author search catches OOM/other exceptions and returns zero. Preserve failures and do not treat an incomplete or memory-restricted search as a full successful reproduction.
optimization.environment_limits: Docker pins torch 1.12.1+cu113 and optuna 3.1.0; pytorch-crf/transformers are not version-pinned.

search.objective: Maximize validation token micro F1; serial Optuna study.
search.top_five: Save five parameter/model records sorted by validation F1. Retraining and evaluation are per-model; no ensemble.
search.paper_transfer: Section 4.3 selects hyperparameters on Data2Text and transfers them to QA and summarization.
search.repository_inventory_result: No winning/top5 JSON, trained classifier checkpoint or Optuna database in the locked repository tree.
search.author_test_callback: Evaluates and records test after trials; objective returns validation F1. Must defer this callback in our sealed-test setting.
proposed_exact_selection_priority: Recover the authors' Data2Text-selected parameter JSON and use the original supplied-parameter retraining branch.
If unavailable, separately reproduce the author Data2Text selection; not authorized/executed in this task.
search.alternate_name_if_qa_search: MVA author-code QA-search transfer; not exact reproduction of the paper's Data2Text-to-QA hyperparameter selection.

outputs.official_decoder: CRF Viterbi decode; binary sequence, consecutive positives form end-exclusive spans.
outputs.primary_metric: Token micro precision/recall/F1: sum token-set intersections and predicted/gold positive lengths over all answers.
outputs.saved_emissions_warning: Two-dimensional output logits are local CRF emissions, not marginal probabilities.
outputs.common_task_reporting: Only after the full method identity is frozen and run: deterministically map the frozen Viterbi binary token sequence to each project 4-BPE window by max over its token positions, then set the common answer score to max over every eligible mapped window. The adapter has no parameters, training, label access, re-decoding or smoothing. Freeze outputs before applying the common thresholds and F1/AUROC/AP; keep native token micro-F1 separate.

unresolved_before_formal_run: Published Data2Text-selected parameter record is absent; constructor defaults are not a justified substitute.
Choose and explicitly name paper-parameter transfer versus code-search transfer; do not silently resolve paper/code search differences.
Lock development-only/final-test padding and partition-wise standardization scope without reading sealed test now.
Freeze exact raw-token character label adapter and report native token metrics separately from old lexical 4-BPE metrics.
Original batch64/full bidirectional Transformer and retained attention may exceed 8GB; measure without changing structure/budget or silently selecting only fitting trials.
conclusion: Classifier structure, loss and Viterbi are recoverable. Existing author-code-exact statistics are only MVA inputs. This document is a source-audited specification, not a completed baseline or selected configuration. Formal window and answer scores remain N/A.
